name: wspolpracuj.my-dev
postCreateCommand: sh -lc 'set -e; SLN=$(find /workspace /workspaces -maxdepth 5 -name "*.sln" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -z "$SLN" ]; then echo "Nie znaleziono pliku .sln w /workspace ani /workspaces"; echo "Zawartosc /workspace:"; ls -la /workspace 2>/dev/null || true; echo "Zawartosc /workspaces:"; ls -la /workspaces 2>/dev/null || true; exit 1; fi; echo "Restore: $SLN"; for attempt in 1 2 3; do if dotnet restore "$SLN"; then break; fi; if [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi; echo "Restore failed, retrying ($attempt/3)..."; done; dotnet tool restore'
